# Name Usage

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:NameUsage`](gmeow-NameUsage.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/NameUsage>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/names`](../../slices/names.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A reified, context-dependent use of an appellation — an observation in the universal claim stack (observation-spine bridge): a named entity ([`observedFeature`](../properties/gmeow-observedFeature.md)) is called by a given appellation ([`observationResult`](../properties/gmeow-observationResult.md)), by or among a particular audience (or within a relationship scope), in a particular register, over a period, on some evidence. Perspectival — a usage is whoever's, never a global fact — so it carries no notion of a preferred or canonical name. Mint one [`NameUsage`](gmeow-NameUsage.md) per (appellation, audience, register) tuple; its period is carried by [`gmeow:usageInterval`](../properties/gmeow-usageInterval.md) or by [`validFrom`](../properties/gmeow-validFrom.md)/validUntil on the statement.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Observation`](gmeow-Observation.md), [`gufo:Relator`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:NameUsage`](gmeow-NameUsage.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Observation`](gmeow-Observation.md), [`gufo:Relator`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use when a name-bearing fact needs its own audience, register, authority, period, evidence, confidence, or standpoint.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for the 80 percent case where an entity simply bears a co-equal appellation; use [`gmeow:hasName`](../properties/gmeow-hasName.md) or [`gmeow:hasAppellation`](../properties/gmeow-hasAppellation.md) and promote only when context must be first-class.

### How to use

- Mint one [`NameUsage`](gmeow-NameUsage.md) per appellation-and-context use, bind the players with [`usageNamed`](../properties/gmeow-usageNamed.md) and [`usageAppellation`](../properties/gmeow-usageAppellation.md), then add [`usageNamer`](../properties/gmeow-usageNamer.md), [`usageAudience`](../properties/gmeow-usageAudience.md), [`usageRegister`](../properties/gmeow-usageRegister.md), [`usageInterval`](../properties/gmeow-usageInterval.md), evidence, or statement metadata as needed; never use it to choose a primary name.

### Examples

- ex:usageFamily a [`gmeow:NameUsage`](gmeow-NameUsage.md); [`gmeow:usageNamed`](../properties/gmeow-usageNamed.md) ex:genny; [`gmeow:usageAppellation`](../properties/gmeow-usageAppellation.md) ex:gennyAunt; [`gmeow:usageAudience`](../properties/gmeow-usageAudience.md) ex:family.
